verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents SharePoint REST CRUD, $batch, Graph read-write access and list webhooks, but nothing describes a delta query, change token or cursor endpoint that returns only changes since the last call. Webhooks that notify of list changes without polling belong to a separate push-notification story and do not show an incremental-sync pull endpoint.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync efficiently — a cursor/delta endpoint returns only what changed since my last call instead of forcing a full re-crawl
